interface.longDescription: A skills-only engineering toolkit that bundles the complete vendored AI Hero / Matt Pocock, Ponytail, Addy Osmani Agent Skills, and Taste Skill collections, plus a dedicated EngineeringSuite router. Use commands such as EngineeringSuite /research, /tdd, /review, /taste, /audit, or an exact upstream skill name to route work to the requested skill. The upstream skill content is preserved and third-party licenses are included. This is a community integration and is not endorsed by the upstream authors.
